note: 24 节气定义与养生要点。index 按通行顺序(立春=1 … 大寒=24;霜降=18);solar_longitude 为太阳黄经(度)。wellness 为通用要点;constitution_season_tips 为九种体质在四季的调养侧重,与节气要点组合成「今日」页提示。来源字段为知识层溯源用,正式入库前需中医顾问逐条核对。
timezone_policy: 交节时刻以用户所在时区落到日历日;节气卡显示交节时刻,便于与按北京时间的中国日历对照。

wellness.principle_en: Raise yang, soothe the liver
wellness.tip_zh: 立春阳气初生。多吃辛甘发散的芽菜,少酸;早起伸展,舒展一冬蜷缩的筋骨。
wellness.tip_en: Yang begins to rise at Start of Spring. Favor pungent, sweet sprouting vegetables over sour; stretch out a winter's worth of stiffness in the morning.

wellness.principle_en: Strengthen the spleen, clear damp, guard against late cold snaps
wellness.tip_zh: 雨水湿气渐重、乍暖还寒。衣服别脱太快,饮食健脾为先,少吃寒凉和甜腻。
wellness.tip_en: Dampness grows at Rain Water and warmth comes and goes. Don't shed layers too fast; eat to support the spleen and go easy on cold and sweet food.

wellness.principle_en: Move with rising yang, light food for the liver
wellness.tip_zh: 惊蛰万物复苏,人也容易肝火上升、口干。多喝水、吃梨,早睡;户外快走让阳气顺畅升发。
wellness.tip_en: Everything wakes at Awakening of Insects, and liver heat and dry mouth are common. Drink water, eat pear, sleep early, and walk briskly outdoors.

wellness.principle_en: Balance yin and yang; neither too cold nor too hot
wellness.tip_zh: 春分昼夜平分,养生讲平衡。饮食寒热搭配,情绪也别大起大落;午后晒太阳,晚上按时睡。
wellness.tip_en: Day and night are equal at Spring Equinox; the keyword is balance. Pair cooling with warming foods, keep moods even, catch afternoon sun and sleep on time.

wellness.principle_en: Soften the liver, nourish the lungs, guard against wind and allergies
wellness.tip_zh: 清明风大、花粉多,过敏体质注意防护。饮食清淡柔润,少吃发物;踏青疏解情绪,但别受风。
wellness.tip_en: Pure Brightness brings wind and pollen; allergy-prone people take care. Eat light and moistening, limit trigger foods, and get outdoors without catching a chill.

wellness.principle_en: Support the spleen, resolve damp, protect the joints
wellness.tip_zh: 谷雨雨水多、湿气重,关节不适者注意保暖防潮。多吃健脾利湿的食材,饭后散步。
wellness.tip_en: Grain Rain is wet and damp; mind the joints and stay dry. Favor spleen-strengthening, damp-draining foods and walk after meals.

wellness.principle_en: Nourish the heart, calm the spirit, eat light
wellness.tip_zh: 立夏心火渐旺,容易心烦、睡不安。饮食清淡、略带苦味,午间小憩 20 分钟,运动别到大汗。
wellness.tip_en: Heart fire rises at Start of Summer, bringing restlessness and lighter sleep. Eat light with a touch of bitter, nap 20 minutes at midday, and stop short of heavy sweating.

wellness.principle_en: Clear heat and damp, mind the skin
wellness.tip_zh: 小满湿热渐起,皮肤问题多发。饮食清淡利湿,少辛辣甜腻;衣物透气,勤换洗。
wellness.tip_en: Damp-heat builds at Grain Buds and skin complaints flare. Eat light and damp-draining, cut spice and sugar, and wear breathable clothes.

wellness.principle_en: Light tonifying for the heart, guard against summer damp
wellness.tip_zh: 芒种闷热多雨,人易困倦。晚睡早起但务必午休;饮食清补,别贪冰饮,出汗后及时换衣。
wellness.tip_en: Grain in Ear is muggy and tiring. Sleep a little later, rise early, and always nap; eat lightly nourishing food, skip iced drinks, change out of sweaty clothes.

wellness.principle_en: Protect yang and yin alike; beat the heat without overcooling
wellness.tip_zh: 夏至阳气最盛、阴气初生。防暑但别贪凉,空调别对着吹,腹部盖好;运动放在清晨或傍晚。
wellness.tip_en: Yang peaks and yin is born at Summer Solstice. Stay cool without overdoing it: no air-con blasting, keep the belly covered, exercise at dawn or dusk.

wellness.principle_en: Cool the heart, relieve summer heat, resolve damp
wellness.tip_zh: 小暑湿热交蒸,胃口差、易乏力。少量多餐、清淡易消化;荷叶茶、绿豆汤解暑,心静自然凉。
wellness.tip_en: Minor Heat steams with damp heat; appetite and energy dip. Eat smaller, lighter meals; lotus-leaf tea and mung-bean soup cool the body, a calm mind cools the rest.

wellness.principle_en: Prevent heatstroke, hydrate, treat winter ailments in summer
wellness.tip_zh: 大暑最热,补水为先,少量多次。阳虚、怕冷的人反而是温养的好时机——这就是“冬病夏治”。
wellness.tip_en: Major Heat is the hottest stretch: hydrate in small, frequent sips. For those who run cold, this is the season to build warmth — treating winter ailments in summer.

wellness.principle_en: Gather inward, nourish the lungs, head off early dryness
wellness.tip_zh: 立秋暑热未退、燥气初起。饮食由清凉转向润燥,多吃梨和百合;别急着“贴秋膘”,等天真正凉下来。
wellness.tip_en: Heat lingers at Start of Autumn while dryness begins. Shift from cooling toward moistening — pear, lily bulb — and don't rush into heavy autumn eating.

wellness.principle_en: Nourish yin, moisten dryness, early to bed and rise
wellness.tip_zh: 处暑暑气渐消,昼夜温差拉大。早睡早起,睡前温水;饮食滋阴润燥,皮肤开始干的人多喝水、少洗太热的澡。
wellness.tip_en: Heat fades at End of Heat and day–night swings widen. Sleep and rise early; eat yin-nourishing, moistening food; if skin dries, drink more and skip very hot showers.

wellness.principle_en: Moisten the lungs, cover the ankles
wellness.tip_zh: “白露身不露”:夜凉露重,别再赤脚、露脚踝。饮食润燥,早晨一碗银耳或山药粥。
wellness.tip_en: At White Dew the nights turn cool and damp — no more bare feet or ankles. Eat to moisten: white-fungus or yam congee in the morning.

wellness.principle_en: Balance yin and yang; moisten the lungs, avoid chills
wellness.tip_zh: 秋分昼夜再度平分,之后夜长昼短。饮食平润,早晚添衣;秋日易生悲,多见朋友、多晒太阳。
wellness.tip_en: Day and night balance again at Autumn Equinox, then nights lengthen. Eat mild and moistening, layer up morning and evening; autumn can lower mood — seek friends and sunlight.

wellness.principle_en: Moisten, gather in, sleep early, keep the feet warm
wellness.tip_zh: 寒露燥气当令、夜寒渐重。多吃梨、百合、银耳,少辛辣;睡前温水泡脚,护好脚和腰腹。
wellness.tip_en: Dryness prevails at Cold Dew and nights grow cold. More pear, lily bulb and white fungus, less spice; soak the feet before bed and keep feet and lower back warm.

wellness.principle_en: Gentle nourishment, moistening, warmth
wellness.tip_zh: 霜降是秋季最后一个节气,昼夜温差大。护住脖颈、腰腹和脚;饮食平补,多吃芝麻、山药、梨,少辛辣。民间说“补冬不如补霜降”。
wellness.tip_en: Frost's Descent is autumn's last term, with big day–night swings. Keep neck, waist and feet warm; eat gently nourishing food — sesame, yam, pear — and go easy on spice.

wellness.principle_en: Store essence, nourish the kidneys, begin warm tonifying
wellness.tip_zh: 立冬万物收藏,进补季节正式开始。温补为主但别过量;早睡晚起,等日出后再运动,护好腰膝。
wellness.tip_en: Everything turns inward at Start of Winter and the tonifying season opens. Warm foods in moderation; sleep early, rise late, exercise after sunrise, guard the lower back and knees.

wellness.principle_en: Warm and protect; lift the spirits
wellness.tip_zh: 小雪天寒日短,容易情绪低落。温补的同时配点萝卜防上火;白天多出门见光,晚上早点休息。
wellness.tip_en: Minor Snow brings cold and short days that dampen mood. Pair warming food with radish to avoid overheating; get daylight by day and rest early at night.

wellness.principle_en: Warm yang against the cold; cover head and feet
wellness.tip_zh: 大雪严寒,出门戴帽围巾,护好头和脚。晨起别急着起床,先在被窝里活动手脚;心脑血管不好的人尤其注意保暖。
wellness.tip_en: Major Snow is bitter: hat and scarf outdoors, warm feet always. Move your limbs before getting out of bed; those with heart or vascular concerns take extra care against cold.

wellness.principle_en: Yang is reborn; rest quietly and protect it
wellness.tip_zh: 冬至阴极阳生,是养生的关键节点。静养为主,早睡,后背晒太阳;温补一餐,但别大吃大喝。
wellness.tip_en: At Winter Solstice yang is reborn from deepest yin — a key moment. Rest, sleep early, warm your back in the sun; one warming meal, without overindulging.

wellness.principle_en: Warm tonifying, store yang, guard the kidneys
wellness.tip_zh: 小寒是一年中最冷的节气之一。早晚护好腰和脚,晚饭可来一碗温补的汤;早睡晚起,等太阳出来再活动。
wellness.tip_en: Minor Cold is among the coldest terms. Keep lower back and feet warm, have a warming soup at dinner, and rise after the sun does.

wellness.principle_en: Consolidate the root, pass winter steadily
wellness.tip_zh: 大寒已近立春,进补收尾、转向平和。少吃油腻,多喝温水,给脾胃减负,为春天做准备。
wellness.tip_en: Major Cold sits just before spring. Wind down heavy tonics toward mild food, drink warm water and ease the digestion ahead of spring.

pinghe.zh: 顺应春生,早起舒展,饮食清淡即可。
pinghe.en: Follow spring's rising energy: stretch in the morning, eat light.

qixu.zh: 春季多风易感冒,出门加件外套,别赶时间快跑。
qixu.en: Spring wind brings colds easily — take a jacket and don't rush.

yangxu.zh: 倒春寒最伤阳虚,衣服晚点脱,早晨晒晒后背。
yangxu.en: Late cold snaps hit yang deficiency hardest: shed layers slowly and sun your back in the morning.

yinxu.zh: 春燥加上肝火,多喝水、少熬夜,晚上一碗百合粥。
yinxu.en: Spring dryness plus liver heat: drink more, sleep earlier, lily-bulb congee at night.

tanshi.zh: 春湿困脾,今天走够 6000 步,少吃甜腻。
tanshi.en: Spring damp weighs on the spleen — 6,000 steps today, skip the sweets.

shire.zh: 春天别贪辣,清淡一天,皮肤会感谢你。
shire.en: Hold the chili this spring; a light day is kind to your skin.

xueyu.zh: 春主生发,多活动肩背,每小时起来走 3 分钟。
xueyu.en: Spring favors movement — open the shoulders and back, stand up every hour.

qiyu.zh: 春应肝,最适合疏解情绪:午后出门,约个朋友。
qiyu.en: Spring belongs to the liver — the best season to unwind: get out this afternoon, call a friend.

tebing.zh: 花粉季来了,早晚戴口罩,回家洗脸换衣。
tebing.en: Pollen season is here: mask up early and late, wash your face and change when home.

pinghe.zh: 夏养心,午休 20 分钟,运动放在清晨或傍晚。
pinghe.en: Summer nourishes the heart: a 20-minute nap, exercise at dawn or dusk.

qixu.zh: 暑热耗气,少量多次补水,别在烈日下久待。
qixu.en: Summer heat drains qi — sip water often, stay out of the midday sun.

yangxu.zh: 冬病夏治正当时:少冰饮、不对着空调吹,腹部盖好。
yangxu.en: Treat winter ailments in summer: no iced drinks, no air-con blasting, keep the belly covered.

yinxu.zh: 夏季出汗伤阴,多喝温水,晚上吃点银耳或梨。
yinxu.en: Summer sweat taxes yin — warm water through the day, white fungus or pear at night.

tanshi.zh: 暑湿最重,管住甜饮和啤酒,出点微汗最好。
tanshi.en: Peak damp-heat: skip sugary drinks and beer; a light sweat is ideal.

shire.zh: 湿热体质的难熬季节:清淡、利湿,勤换衣,少熬夜。
shire.en: A hard season for damp-heat types: light, damp-draining food, fresh clothes, early nights.

xueyu.zh: 天热血行畅,正好多活动;别久坐空调房。
xueyu.en: Heat moves the blood — a good time to be active; don't sit all day in air-conditioning.

qiyu.zh: 心静自然凉,午后听听音乐,别把烦躁憋着。
qiyu.en: A calm mind cools the body: music in the afternoon, and let irritation out rather than in.

tebing.zh: 换季已过,但汗多易起疹,保持干爽,少吃海鲜发物。
tebing.en: Pollen has eased, but sweat can trigger rashes — stay dry and limit seafood triggers.

pinghe.zh: 顺应秋收,早睡早起,饮食清润。
pinghe.en: Follow autumn's gathering: early to bed, early to rise, light and moistening food.

qixu.zh: 气虚体质秋季易感冒,出门加件外套,别赶时间快跑。
qixu.en: Qi deficiency catches autumn colds easily. Take a jacket; don't rush.

yangxu.zh: 秋凉阳气渐收,早晚护好腰腹和脚,今晚泡脚。
yangxu.en: Yang withdraws as autumn cools. Keep lower back, belly and feet warm; soak your feet tonight.

yinxu.zh: 秋燥伤阴,今天多喝温水,晚上来一碗银耳羹。
yinxu.en: Autumn dryness taxes yin — warm water through the day, white-fungus soup tonight.

tanshi.zh: 秋高气爽正适合活动,今天走够 6000 步。
tanshi.en: Crisp autumn air is made for moving — 6,000 steps today.

shire.zh: 天凉了也别贪辣,清淡一天。
shire.en: Cooler weather is no excuse for chili. Keep it light today.

xueyu.zh: 久坐伤血,每小时起来活动 3 分钟。
xueyu.en: Long sitting stagnates blood. Stand and move 3 minutes every hour.

qiyu.zh: 秋日易生悲,午后出门晒晒太阳,约个朋友。
qiyu.en: Autumn invites low spirits. Get afternoon sun and call a friend.

tebing.zh: 换季是过敏高发期,早晚戴口罩,回家洗脸。
tebing.en: Season change means allergy season. Mask up early and late; wash your face when home.

pinghe.zh: 冬主藏,早睡晚起,温补一餐就好,别过量。
pinghe.en: Winter is for storing: sleep early, rise late, one warming meal is enough.

qixu.zh: 冬天别硬扛寒风,出门戴帽围巾,回家喝碗热汤。
qixu.en: Don't brave the wind on empty: hat and scarf out, hot soup when home.

yangxu.zh: 阳虚最怕冬,腰腹和脚是重点,晚饭可来碗羊肉汤。
yangxu.en: Winter is hardest on yang deficiency: lower back, belly and feet first; lamb soup suits dinner.

yinxu.zh: 暖气房里更干,多喝水、少吃辛辣,温补要选平和的。
yinxu.en: Heated rooms dry you further — drink more, less spice, and choose mild tonics.

tanshi.zh: 冬天少动易生痰湿,室内也要活动,少吃肥甘。
tanshi.en: Less movement in winter breeds phlegm-damp: keep moving indoors, go easy on rich food.

shire.zh: 火锅季节到了,辛辣烟酒还是要节制。
shire.en: Hotpot season — spice, alcohol and tobacco still call for restraint.

xueyu.zh: 天冷血行迟缓,出门前先活动手脚,别久坐。
xueyu.en: Cold slows the blood: move your limbs before heading out, and don't sit too long.

qiyu.zh: 冬日短、情绪低,白天多见光,找人聊聊。
qiyu.en: Short days lower mood — get daylight, and talk to someone.

tebing.zh: 室内尘螨和干冷空气是冬天的过敏源,勤通风、戴口罩。
tebing.en: Indoor dust mites and cold dry air are winter's triggers: ventilate often, wear a mask outside.
